act_title: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 & State Tenancy Provisions (e.g. Telangana / Karnataka)
authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / State Urban Development Departments

sources.title: Security Deposit Limits and Refund Timeline
sources.summary: Security deposit for residential premises shall not exceed two months' rent, and for non-residential premises shall not exceed six months' rent. Deposit must be refunded to the tenant upon handing over vacant possession of the premises, after making legitimate deductions for any arrears of rent or damages.

sources.title: Written Tenancy Agreement & Rent Revision
sources.summary: No person shall let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing. Revision of rent must be in accordance with terms of the tenancy agreement, requiring at least three months' prior written notice to tenant before revision takes effect.
keywords: three months notice for rent revision

sources.title: Maintenance and Repair Responsibilities
sources.summary: Both landlord and tenant are bound to keep premises in good condition according to division of responsibilities. If landlord fails to carry out necessary structural repairs after notice, tenant can carry out repairs and deduct expenses from rent (up to 50% of monthly rent) or approach the Rent Authority.

sources.title: Restriction on Eviction and Entry
sources.summary: No landlord shall cut off or withhold any essential supply or service (water, electricity, access). Eviction can only be sought through application before the Rent Court on specified statutory grounds such as persistent rent default or misuse.
